extensionDescription.message: Lee inglés en la web: palabras desconocidas resaltadas, porcentaje honesto. Sin conexión y privado.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description: the extensions page, and both stores' summary. At most 112 characters (Apple's limit). Names the languages a Spanish reader can study in the shipped pairs (English, en-es) — not a translation of the French. Tú, neutral Spanish.

commandCaptureSelection.message: Capturar la selección (palabra o expresión) con su frase
commandCaptureSelection.description: The Alt+L command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: capture the selected word or phrase together with its sentence.

commandToggleDrawer.message: Abrir o cerrar el panel de repaso en la página
commandToggleDrawer.description: The Alt+Shift+D command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open or close the in-page review panel (the drawer).

commandSidePanel.message: Abrir el panel lateral de repaso
commandSidePanel.description: The Alt+Shift+S command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open the browser's review side panel (Chromium).
